projects.name: Agent Circuit Breaker
projects.question: Should this agent action execute?
projects.description: Deterministic action and trajectory checks, plus a stateful runtime gate with exact approvals and durable local run state for trusted agent integrations.
projects.scope: Strongest path: single-host trusted RuntimeGate integration with every protected side effect mediated and workers sharing a local SQLite store. CLI/API and MCP evaluation have distinct advisory or adapter boundaries. UNKNOWN is not execution authority. Not an OS sandbox or distributed coordinator.

projects.name: Horizon Agent Containment
projects.question: What can this agent become capable of?
projects.description: A deterministic stateful engine that tracks provenance, authority, relationships, and emergent capabilities, then evaluates security invariants before committing a transition.
projects.scope: Research prototype around explicitly modeled state and invariants. The project page replays recorded Python engine results. A trusted integration must accurately model effects and honor the decision; unmodeled tool actions remain outside scope.
